comparative.text: [The Ophidia] Veratrum album, but in this drug the chill is associated with thirst, and (if internal) runs downward, not upward. Skin blue, cold, in- elastic; hands blue; face, mouth and tongue cold; breathing op- pressed and labored; heart weak; cold, clammy sweat, worse on the forehead. Heat has no palliative effect.

repertory.text: Generalities: Perforate or become phagedenic: Uncover
